name: Waza
title_zh: 把工程习惯固化成 Claude 可跑的技能包
tagline_zh: 不用重新发明 prompt，把你日常的 git、调试、代码审查习惯直接变成 skill。装一次。
tagline_en: Stop re-inventing prompts. Turn your daily git, debug, and code-review habits into skills Claude just runs.
desc_en: 🥷 Engineering habits you already know, turned into skills Claude can run.
why_zh: 它不教新东西，而是把你已有的工作流打包成可复用技能。仓库本身就是一套精选集合，装完即用，省去从零调教。
why_en: It doesn't teach new tricks—it packages your existing workflow into reusable skills. A curated collection, install and go.
limit_zh: 只覆盖工程习惯（git、调试、审查），不含写作、数据分析等域。技能依赖你的本地环境，若 Claude 无对应工具链（如。
limit_en: Only covers engineering habits (git, debug, review). Requires local toolchain (gh, jq, etc.); without them, skills fail silently.
